Folder.Name: BackupBizTalkServerBizTalkMgmtDb
Folder.File:
$bkpDir = "c:\BizTalk\Backups\{0:yyyyMMdd}\" -f (get-date) if (Test-Path $bkpDir) { del $bkpDir\*.* -Force } md $bkpDir cd $bkpDir
&BTSTask.exe ExportBindings -Server:localhost -Database:BizTalkMgmtDb -ApplicationName:CargoWise.eHub -Destination:("CargoWise.eHub.BindingInfo.xml") -GlobalParties
del ($env:TEMP + "\tmp*.cab")

exec [dbo].[sp_BackupAllFull_Schedule] 'd' /* Frequency */, 'BTS' /* Name */, '\\sydwp-sbak-2.wisecloud.zone\Other\Non_DPM_ToTape\WormHole\BIZTLK' /* location of backup files */, 0 /* Force full backup after partial failure */, 21 /* backup hour */, 1 /* use local time */

declare @path nvarchar(250) = 'C:\BizTalk\Backups\' + CONVERT(char(8), GETDATE(), 112)
exec [dbo].[sp_ForceFullBackup]
exec [dbo].[sp_BackupAllFull_Schedule] 'd' /* Frequency */, 'BTS' /* Name */, @path /* location of backup files */
IF sys.fn_hadr_is_primary_replica('BizTalkMgmtDb') = 0 RAISERROR('Instance is secondary replica',11,0)
exec [dbo].[sp_DeleteBackupHistoryAndMarkLogsHistory] @DaysToKeep=14
dir "C:\BizTalk\Backups" | where PSIsContainer | sort -descending | select -skip 7 | del -recurse
exec [dbo].[sp_MarkAll] 'BTS' /* Log mark name */, '\\sydwp-sbak-2.wisecloud.zone\Other\Non_DPM_ToTape\WormHole\BIZTLK' /* location of backup files */
-- exec [dbo].[sp_MarkAll] 'BTS' /* Log mark name */, '<destination path>' /* location of backup files */
exec [dbo].[sp_SetBackupCompression] @bCompression = 1 /*0 - Do not use Compression, 1 - Use Compression */
exec [dbo].[sp_SetBackupCompression] @bCompression = 0 /*0 - Do not use Compression, 1 - Use Compression */

Folder.File: cmd /q /c "For /F "tokens=1 delims=" %v In ('ForFiles /P "$(ESCAPE_SQUOTE(SQLLOGDIR))" /m *_*_*_*.txt /d -30 2^>^&1') do if EXIST "$(ESCAPE_SQUOTE(SQLLOGDIR))"\%v echo del "$(ESCAPE_SQUOTE(SQLLOGDIR))"\%v& del "$(ESCAPE_SQUOTE(SQLLOGDIR))"\%v"
